_comment: How each 1.20.1 project of the original pack (docs/original-manifest-1.20.1.json) maps to 1.21.1 NeoForge. Projects not listed keep their own CurseForge project. tools/resolve_mods.py reads this.

665658.why: Canary is a Forge-only Lithium port; Lithium itself ships NeoForge 1.21.1

563928.why: TerraBlender's NeoForge builds live in a separate CurseForge project

426558.why: Alex's Mobs has no official 1.21.1 build; Raguto's unofficial port keeps the alexsmobs mod id

331936.why: the Alex's Mobs port is built against Raguto's Citadel port

908741.why: Flerovium needs Sodium on 1.21.1, and Sodium ships official NeoForge builds

drop.1150228: Alex's Mobs - Naturalist Compat has no 1.21.1 build; Clanwild (our Core) removes the duplicates instead
drop.790312: Dynamo has no 1.21.1 build; Clanwild (our Core) has its own speed-strike
drop.1002819: JJThunder To The Max has no CurseForge 1.21.1 build and is All Rights Reserved; the giant mountains were not wanted, and Clanlands (our Core) builds the Clan territories from the books instead
drop.303570: Time Control is Forge 1.20 only; Better Days already runs the day/night clock
drop.1072978: VMinus is Forge 1.20.1 only and no config in the pack used it
drop.1400281: Chunk Optimization is Forge 1.20.1 only; Lithium and ModernFix cover performance
drop.503839: Embellished Stone is a skin for Advancement Plaques, which the pack never included
drop.245755: Waystones: teleporting stones undercut the Great Journey, which is meant to be walked
drop.508933: Distant Horizons: its rendering was switched off in the original pack, so it only cost memory and disk
drop.602059: Friends&Foes: its fantasy vanilla-style mobs (moobloom, glare, rascal...) do not belong in the Clans' world
drop.882133: Boss Refreshed (resource pack): no bosses in a Warrior Cats world
drop.580036: Enhanced Boss Bars (resource pack): no bosses in a Warrior Cats world
drop.322713: Blinking Ender Eyes (resource pack): not part of the Clans' world
drop.1242659: The Rename Compat Project (resource pack): not needed

pin_old_version_ok._comment: Resource packs with no 1.21 file: keep the 1.20 file (they are optional and off by default).

add.why: Cristel Lib requires Cloth Config on 1.21.1

notes: Terralith shipped in the instance's datapacks/ folder, which nothing loaded, so it was never active; it stays out.

306612.why: Fabric API for Connector-loaded mods is provided by Forgified Fabric API
